There's no remote configured in this repo, and I don't have details about the "internal remote" (hostname/IP, port, username, or which key to use). Could you share those? For example:

- Git remote URL you're trying to push to (e.g. `git@git.internal.example.com:org/repo.git`)
- The actual SSH hostname/IP and port it resolves to
- Which private key should be used
- The SSH username (often `git`)

Once I have those, I can add an entry like this to `~/.ssh/config`:

```
Host git.internal.example.com
    HostName <actual-ip-or-internal-hostname>
    User git
    Port 22
    IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_internal
    IdentitiesOnly yes
```

and set `git remote add origin git@git.internal.example.com:org/repo.git` (or update the existing remote) to match. Let me know the specifics and I'll wire it up.
